digest.overview: 本期新聞以中國靶材廠動態為主。有研新材公布2026年三季報:前三季營收84.62億元、年增24.98%,歸母淨利2.63億元、年增7.31%;但第三季營收年減13.86%,單季淨利年減30.61%,另計提資產減值準備,股價隨後重挫近10%。報導指其扣非淨利大幅成長、半導體靶材業務表現亮眼。歐萊新材已回覆定增審核問詢函,並提交募集說明書申報稿,融資擴產進入審核階段。JX金屬上調銅建值6萬日圓、創歷史新高,銅系靶材的原料成本壓力升高。其餘多為市調報告與股市資金面消息,與靶材供需的關聯較弱。
key_trends: 原物料成本走高:JX金屬銅建值上調6萬日圓並創新高,高純銅靶材與銅背板的成本可能跟著墊高,報價與長約調價的壓力增加。
半導體靶材成為中國廠的獲利支柱:有研新材單季淨利雖年減30.61%,但扣非淨利大幅成長,半導體靶材業務被點名表現亮眼,顯示產品結構正往高附加價值的半導體應用移動。
中國靶材廠透過資本市場擴產:歐萊新材推進2026年度向特定對象發行A股,已回覆問詢函、提交募集說明書與保薦書,在地供應能力可望持續擴大。
政策資金持續挹注本土材料廠:阿石創獲得736萬元國家項目專項資金餘款,反映中國對關鍵材料國產化的政策支持仍在延續。
高純銅靶材市場穩健成長:市調報告預估半導體用高純度銅濺鍍靶材全球市場年均成長6.6%;Cr-Si合金靶材、TiN金屬硬遮罩PVD及濺鍍設備相關報告也顯示,下游應用需求持續擴展。
資本市場情緒分歧:有研新材財報後股價大跌、江豐電子主力資金淨賣出2316.06萬元,歐萊新材則獲主力資金淨買入1868.38萬元,市場對各廠成長性的評價明顯不同。
watch_points: 有研新材第三季營收與淨利下滑的原因、資產減值的項目與規模,以及半導體靶材營收占比與毛利能否延續;也要留意是否影響其對客戶的報價策略。
歐萊新材定增的審核進度、募資規模與投向的產品線(如顯示面板或半導體靶材),評估新增產能何時開出、對市場價格的衝擊。
銅價後續走勢與JX金屬等上游的報價調整,建議檢視銅靶材合約的原料價格聯動條款,並評估備料時機。
江豐電子、光洋科、Materion、古屋金屬等競爭者即將公布的財報與接單狀況,藉此比較各廠在半導體客戶端的市占變化。
中國國家專項資金與國產化政策對阿石創等本土靶材廠的扶持力道,以及對外資或台系靶材廠在中國市場競爭的影響。

papers.title: A Novel Low–Temperature One–Step Method for Recycling and Resource Utilization of Spent ITO Targets
papers.abstract: Hydrogen reduction of spent indium tin oxide (ITO) targets is a feasible route for indium recovery from electronic waste. However, conventional hydrogen–reduction processes face critical challenges: they operate above 1173 K, inducing severe indium volatilization through gaseous In2O formation and substantial energy consumption. They also require complex downstream separation, purification and alloying procedures to obtain usable indium–based materials. To address these drawbacks, this work develops a Sn–mediated strategy to fundamentally alter the reaction pathway, enabling one–step low–temperature conversion of spent ITO into value–added In52Sn48 alloy. The added metallic Sn transforms direct hydrogen reduction of ITO into a two–step cyclic reaction: Sn first reacts with ITO to form metallic In and SnO, and SnO is subsequently reduced back to Sn by H2. At the optimized Sn/ITO mass ratio of 0.69, the reaction temperature is reduced by 200 K and the holding time is reduced from 2 h to 1 h, effectively suppressing gaseous In2O formation and indium volatilization. Preliminary theoretical energy consumption assessment shows that the total energy consumption is reduced by 48.9%. The present route directly produces In–Sn alloy products, removing tedious downstream separation and purification steps inherent in conventional recovery processes. The proposed strategy is potentially scalable and offers a new direction for the resource utilization of spent ITO.
topics: 濺鍍行為與靶材利用率
papers.summary: 針對廢棄 ITO 靶材回收,提出添加金屬 Sn 的氫還原策略:Sn 先與 ITO 反應生成 In 與 SnO,SnO 再被 H2 還原回 Sn,形成循環反應。在 Sn/ITO 質量比 0.69 時,反應溫度降低 200 K、持溫時間由 2 h 縮短為 1 h,可抑制 In2O 揮發,理論能耗降低 48.9%,並可一步直接製得 In52Sn48 合金,省去後段分離純化步驟。
papers.title_zh: 一種廢 ITO 靶材回收與資源化的新型低溫一步法
papers.abstract_zh: 以氫還原廢氧化銦錫(ITO)靶材是從電子廢棄物回收銦的可行途徑,但傳統氫還原製程須在 1173 K 以上進行,會因生成氣態 In2O 而造成嚴重的銦揮發與高耗能,且需要繁複的後段分離、純化與合金化步驟才能得到可用的銦基材料。本研究提出以 Sn 為媒介的策略,從根本改變反應路徑,一步低溫將廢 ITO 轉化為高附加價值的 In52Sn48 合金。添加的金屬 Sn 使 ITO 的直接氫還原變為兩步循環反應:Sn 先與 ITO 反應生成金屬 In 與 SnO,SnO 再被 H2 還原回 Sn。在最佳 Sn/ITO 質量比 0.69 下,反應溫度降低 200 K,持溫時間由 2 小時縮短為 1 小時,有效抑制氣態 In2O 生成與銦揮發。初步理論能耗評估顯示總能耗降低 48.9%。此路線直接產出 In–Sn 合金,省去傳統回收製程中繁瑣的後段分離與純化步驟,具放大潛力,為廢 ITO 的資源化提供新方向。

papers.title: Hydrothermally assisted sintering of calcium hydroxide sputtering targets: a route to quantum-grade CaO thin films
papers.abstract: Abstract In this report, we demonstrate dense polycrystalline calcium hydroxide ceramics fabricated by hydrothermally assisted sintering—often referred to as cold sintering—to produce high-purity calcium hydroxide targets for calcium oxide thin film deposition. Calcium hydroxide ceramics exhibit up to 98% relative density without thermal dehydration when sintered at temperatures between 100 and 300 °C with 400 MPa applied uniaxial pressure for 1 hour. The brucite phase is preserved in calcium hydroxide targets sintered at all temperatures. Small equivalent fractions of calcium carbonate are present in both the calcium hydroxide precursor powder and final targets suggesting minimal additional carbonate production during formation and densification. Microstructure evolution during densification is documented by scanning electron microscopy (SEM), indicating both mass transport and plastic deformation densification mechanisms. The hydrothermal-assisted sintering process is scaled up to produce 2-inch-diameter calcium hydroxide targets suitable for sputter deposition. We also report epitaxial calcium oxide film deposition from these targets on r -plane sapphire substrates. (002)-oriented epitaxial films are achieved with a time-stable deposition rate of 1.2 nm per minute. We note that energetic bombardment during growth can be substantial, necessitating an off-axis sputter cathode geometry.
topics: 濺鍍行為與靶材利用率
papers.summary: 以水熱輔助燒結(冷燒結)製備高純 Ca(OH)2 陶瓷靶,在 100–300 °C、400 MPa 單軸壓力下持壓 1 h,相對密度可達 98%,且未發生熱脫水、維持 brucite 相;碳酸鈣含量與前驅粉末相當,緻密化機制兼具質量傳輸與塑性變形。製程已放大至 2 吋靶材,可在 r 面藍寶石上鍍出 (002) 取向的磊晶 CaO 膜,沉積速率穩定於 1.2 nm/min,但因高能粒子轟擊明顯,需採用離軸陰極配置。
papers.title_zh: 水熱輔助燒結氫氧化鈣濺鍍靶材:製備量子級 CaO 薄膜的途徑
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究以水熱輔助燒結(又稱冷燒結)製作緻密的多晶氫氧化鈣陶瓷,作為沉積氧化鈣薄膜用的高純度氫氧化鈣靶材。在 100~300 °C、單軸加壓 400 MPa、持壓 1 小時的條件下燒結,氫氧化鈣陶瓷相對密度可達 98%,且未發生熱脫水;各燒結溫度下的靶材皆保留水鎂石(brucite)相。前驅粉末與最終靶材中都含有少量等量的碳酸鈣,顯示成形與緻密化過程幾乎未額外生成碳酸鹽。以掃描式電子顯微鏡(SEM)記錄緻密化過程的顯微組織演變,顯示同時存在質量傳輸與塑性變形兩種緻密化機制。此製程已放大至可製作 2 吋直徑、適用於濺鍍的氫氧化鈣靶材,並以這些靶材在 r 面藍寶石基板上沉積磊晶氧化鈣薄膜,得到 (002) 取向的磊晶膜,沉積速率穩定在每分鐘 1.2 nm。成長過程中的高能粒子轟擊可能相當顯著,因此需採用離軸濺鍍陰極配置。

papers.title: Synthesis of Perovskite-Structured SrTiO3 via the Pechini Method and Deposition of Thin Film by RF Magnetron Sputtering: Structural and Photovoltaic Characterization
papers.abstract: Strontium titanate (SrTiO3) is a stable, non-toxic perovskite oxide that has attracted interest for photovoltaic and optoelectronic applications, including third-generation photovoltaic devices. However, the production of ceramic targets with suitable density and microstructure for sputtering deposition remains a technological challenge. This study investigates a processing route for SrTiO3 ceramic targets and their application in thin-film heterostructures. SrTiO3 powders were synthesized by the Pechini method and densified by Spark Plasma Sintering (SPS), followed by deposition by RF Magnetron Sputtering of thin films. Structural and morphological analyses confirmed the formation of predominantly cubic SrTiO3 and the densified microstructure of the ceramic target. The optical band gap of the films, determined using the Tauc method for an indirect transition, was 3.42 eV for the as-deposited film and 3.35 eV after annealing. The resulting FTO/SrTiO3/CdTe/CdCl2/Au heterostructure exhibited a measurable photoelectric response, with localized photovoltage reaching approximately 400 mV, and photovoltaic parameters of Jsc = 4.32 μA/cm2, Voc = 9.75 mV, and FF = 21.4%. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed processing route for producing SrTiO3 thin films and their integration into photoactive heterostructures.
papers.summary: 以 Pechini 法合成 SrTiO3 粉末,經放電電漿燒結(SPS)製成以立方相為主、組織緻密的陶瓷靶,再以 RF 磁控濺鍍成膜。薄膜能隙為 3.42 eV(退火後 3.35 eV),FTO/SrTiO3/CdTe 異質結構可量測到光電響應;摘要未提供靶材的具體密度數值。
papers.title_zh: 以 Pechini 法合成鈣鈦礦結構 SrTiO3 並以射頻磁控濺鍍沉積薄膜:結構與光伏特性
papers.abstract_zh: 鈦酸鍶(SrTiO3)是穩定、無毒的鈣鈦礦氧化物,在光伏與光電應用(包括第三代光伏元件)上受到關注,但製作密度與顯微組織適合濺鍍沉積的陶瓷靶材仍是技術挑戰。本研究探討 SrTiO3 陶瓷靶材的製程路線及其在薄膜異質結構中的應用:以 Pechini 法合成 SrTiO3 粉末,經放電電漿燒結(SPS)緻密化,再以射頻磁控濺鍍沉積薄膜。結構與形貌分析確認主要形成立方相 SrTiO3,且陶瓷靶材組織緻密。以 Tauc 法(間接躍遷)測得薄膜光學能隙,沉積態為 3.42 eV,退火後為 3.35 eV。FTO/SrTiO3/CdTe/CdCl2/Au 異質結構具可量測的光電響應,局部光電壓約 400 mV,光伏參數為 Jsc = 4.32 μA/cm2、Voc = 9.75 mV、FF = 21.4%。結果證明此製程路線可用於製作 SrTiO3 薄膜並整合進光活性異質結構。
